title: Critique: the view says too little about what cosmic consciousness is

statements.text: Cosmopsychism is silent about exactly what cosmic consciousness is, and without that it is incomplete. Nagasawa and Wager reply that panpsychism says just as little about the consciousness of physical ultimates, and that it is hard to imagine what cosmic consciousness could be like, but its existence cannot be ruled out.
